job_description:
Dice is the leading career destination for tech experts at every stage of their careers. Our client, TechVirtue LLC, is seeking the following. Apply via Dice today!

• *Role: MSBI Developer
• *Location: Washington, DC
• *Duration: Long Term
• *Job Description

An MSBI Developer is responsible for building, enhancing, and supporting Business Intelligence solutions using Microsoft BI technologies, with a strong focus on SSIS and Microsoft Fabric. The role involves data integration, data modeling, and delivering reliable analytics solutions for business users.
• *Key Responsibilities**

Design, develop, and maintain ETL pipelines using SSIS and Microsoft Fabric Data Factory
Integrate data from multiple sources into data warehouses and lake houses

Build and manage Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse/Warehouse solutions

Develop datasets and reports using Power BI within Fabric

Optimize SQL Server queries, stored procedures, and data models

Ensure data quality, performance, and scalability of BI solutions

Provide production support and resolve data-related issues

Collaborate with business and technical teams to gather reporting requirements

• *Required Skills**

Strong experience with SQL Server
Hands-on experience with SSIS, SSRS and SSAS

Experience with Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Lakehouse, Warehouse)

Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts (facts, dimensions, star schema)

Experience with Power BI and basic DAX

Knowledge of ETL, data validation, and performance tuning
